blocks.title: Iwahori-Hecke algebras
blocks.content:
2020 Mathematics Subject Classiﬁcation: Primary - 20C08, 57K14, 57K18
Abstract
We give a simple construction of Markov traces for Iwahori–Hecke algebras associated with the crystallographic
Coxeter groups of types An, Bn and Dn. In types B and D, it is new and generalises a known construction in type A
employing symmetric polynomials in multiplicative Jucys–Murphy elements.

blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.content:
A two-variable link invariant – the HOMFLY-PT polynomial – can be recovered using a family of trace
functions on Iwahori–Hecke algebras in type A satisfying analogues of the conditions in Markov’s the-
orem for the braid group (usually called ‘Markov moves’) [10]. The analogues of Markov moves can
be formulated for Iwahori–Hecke algebras of other Coxeter groups, leading to a general notion of the
Markov trace, see, for example, [3, 5, 7, 20]. The Markov traces were classiﬁed in type A, where there
is, up to some change of scaling, a unique Markov trace, by Ocneanu and Jones [10], and in types

The elements JA k are sometimes called multiplicative Jucys–Murphy elements in the Iwahori–Hecke algebra of type A. There seems to be no agreement in the literature on which elements to call the Jucys–Murphy elements in other types. We chose our convention because under it the deﬁnition of the Jucys–Murphy element is uniform in all types, but elements jX k for X = B, D deﬁned below arguably also deserve the name.
